title: What's your workflow for 3D humanoid character animations?
author: Faisal_alwaal
selftext:
I'm currently developing a 3D game in Godot, and my animation workflow consists of Kimodo + Motion Matching, with Claude Opus 5.5 handling the implementation, integration, and refinement.

So far, the results have been pretty decent, but I'm still spending a lot of time tweaking and polishing animations, especially character movement, transitions, and jumping.

I'm curious whether my current approach is efficient or if there are better workflows I should consider.

What do you guys use for 3D humanoid animations? Do you rely on motion capture, AI-generated animations, procedural animation, or a combination of different techniques?

I'd love to hear about your workflows, tools, and any recommendations you might have!
